capabilities: Auto-correct typos, case and spacing errors silently while typing
Undo any correction by pressing Backspace immediately
Add words to custom dictionaries via status bar, ribbon, context menu or bulk paste
Expand toggleable clinical shorthands like pt, hx, dx and rx
Review recent fixes in an auto-corrections panel with confidence meters
extras: Desktop only. Frequency dictionaries (~6.5 MB) are downloaded on request and are the plugin's only network access. Includes a medical disclaimer that expanded shorthands and corrected drug names can be wrong. Plugin is not yet reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: On desktop the plugin asks Obsidian's built-in Chromium spellchecker whether a word is misspelled
problem: Obsidian's built-in spellchecker only underlines misspellings; it does not silently correct typos or spacing errors while you type.
summary: Real-time autocorrect spellchecker that silently fixes typos as you type, with a status bar, dictionary manager, clinical shorthands and medical sub-dictionaries.
